text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Hrmm, next is dumbbell shoulder presses
for the deltoids――

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer <username>!
Thanks for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
D-Did I say that out loud?
I'm so sorry, ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I was rethinking the strength training menu for Meek.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume's body is packed with potential...
but by that same token, failing to train it in a balanced manner
carries significant risks.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I absolutely cannot let Meek get injured.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Once I get back to my room, I will reread the Kiryuin family secret 'Trainer's White Paper' and deliberate thoroughly upon thoroughly!
choice_data_list: Please don't push yourself too hard.
I'd love to see the Trainer White Paper.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes, self-management is essential!
I must always conduct myself as a role model for Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Actually, no matter how late I stay up,
my skin is naturally resistant to dark circles under my eyes!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
So, I won't cause my trainee any worry.
Leave it to me!

I soothed the fired-up Trainer Kiryuin,
explaining that wasn't what I meant.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
My goodness! Trainer <username>,
are you interested in the Kiryuin family teachings?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I believe you already possess a splendid training philosophy just the way you are, but...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Still, hearing you say that makes me very happy!
If you'd like, I can lend you the volume I have with me now.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
By the way... there are about forty more volumes.
Shall I bring those along next time as well?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I've memorized all the contents,
so feel free to return it whenever you like!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Rereading it tonight is practically a ritual to get myself all fired up again!
